verses.pali: “Seyyathāpi, bhikkhave, ye keci devānaṁ tāvatiṁsānaṁ rukkhā, pārichattako tesaṁ aggamakkhāyati;
verses.english: “Mendicants, of all the trees belonging to the gods of the thirty-three, the Orchid Tree is said to be the best.

verses.pali: evameva kho, bhikkhave, ye keci bodhipakkhiyā dhammā, paññindriyaṁ tesaṁ aggamakkhāyati, yadidaṁ—bodhāya.
verses.english: In the same way, the faculty of wisdom is said to be the best of the qualities on the side of awakening; that is, for becoming awakened.
And what are the qualities on the side of awakening?

verses.pali: Saddhindriyaṁ, bhikkhave, bodhipakkhiyo dhammo, taṁ bodhāya saṁvattati.
paññindriyaṁ bodhipakkhiyo dhammo, taṁ bodhāya saṁvattati.
verses.english: and wisdom are qualities on the side of awakening, in that they lead to awakening.

verses.pali: Seyyathāpi, bhikkhave, ye keci devānaṁ tāvatiṁsānaṁ rukkhā, pārichattako tesaṁ aggamakkhāyati;
verses.english: Of all the trees belonging to the gods of the thirty-three, the Orchid Tree is said to be the best.

verses.pali: evameva kho, bhikkhave, ye keci bodhipakkhiyā dhammā, paññindriyaṁ tesaṁ aggamakkhāyati, yadidaṁ—bodhāyā”ti.
verses.english: In the same way, the faculty of wisdom is said to be the best of the qualities on the side of awakening; that is, for becoming awakened.”
